description: Attach a handle, hashtag or keyword attribution alias. A handle alias marks that platform account as brand-owned and requires its platform; it does not monitor the account; no collection cost. Changes only the requested workspace state. Backend authorization, validation and any quote/approval, budget and idempotency controls remain authoritative; tool selection does not authorize additional work.

platform.description: Required for a handle: the platform the account is on.

workspaceId.description: Authorized workspace for this requested write; discover accessible context first.
